title: On $C^2$ circle diffeomorphisms with rotation numbers of constant type
summary: For every irrational rotation number $α$ of constant type and every $q>1$, we construct a $C^2$ circle diffeomorphism $F$ arbitrarily close to the rigid rotation $R_α$ in the combined $C^2$ and $B^2_{2,q}$ topology whose normalized conjugacy is not Lipschitz. We also prove that $F''\in B^0_{2,1}$ implies global $C^1$ conjugacy. Thus the thresholds in the Besov summability and weak Dini scales are $q=1$ and $γ=1/2$, respectively.
